# LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits — concept pack (small)

> 12 source-anchored research claims on LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits, grouped by facet. Original confidence and source-owner limits are retained.

## Definitions

- [fact] Database-backed virtual keys require PostgreSQL and a configured proxy master key. The global max_budget setting does not enforce a spend cap when no database is connected. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/virtual_keys · keywords: LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits · also: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/users, https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/security_owasp_llm_top10

## How it works

- [fact] LiteLLM TPM counting defaults to input plus output and can select input or output globally. Admission reserves estimated tokens before reconciling real usage; missing output bounds can therefore cause over-admission or unexpected rejection. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/users · keywords: LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/proxy/hooks/parallel_request_limiter_v3.py
- [fact] Budget reservation is enabled unless disable_budget_reservation is true. It estimates request cost before dispatch and settles reservations against calculated response cost; disabling it permits concurrent requests to exceed a recorded-spend ceiling. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/users · keywords: LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/proxy/spend_tracking/budget_reservation.py, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/proxy/auth/user_api_key_auth.py

## Parameters and configuration

- [statement] default_key_generate_params fills missing or null fields. Its budget_duration exception lets an explicit null skip that configured default and create a budget that never resets, unless upperbound_key_generate_params applies. Upperbounds also supply defaults, including budget_duration when missing or null, and reject excessive values rather than silently clamping them. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/virtual_keys
- [fact] A key duration controls credential expiry; budget_duration controls spend-window resets. Do not use a budget reset interval as a substitute for expiring or revoking a credential. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/virtual_keys · keywords: LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits · also: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/users
- [statement] The current budget guide marks virtual-key model_max_budget as an Enterprise-licensed feature. Check the installed license and release before relying on per-model dollar budgets. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/users

## How-to and procedures

- [fact] Classify 429 responses before retrying. Transient provider rate limits can carry retry-after, while exhausted spend access persists until the budget or account state changes; repeatedly resending requests cannot repair a spend cap. — https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/rate-limits · keywords: LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits · also: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [fact] When budget reservations or rate counters cannot be verified, the opt-in fail_closed_budget_enforcement and fail_closed_rate_limit_enforcement paths can reject with HTTP 503. Treat this as an availability tradeoff and test the exact entity and route. — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/proxy/spend_tracking/budget_reservation.py · keywords: LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/proxy/hooks/parallel_request_limiter_v3.py, https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/security_owasp_llm_top10
- [statement] LiteLLM prices spend from its model cost information. The spend guide warns that missing rates can produce usage-bearing zero-dollar records; reconcile pricing and provider billing instead of assuming zero tracked spend means free inference. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/cost_tracking
- [statement] Batch submission contains input_file_id, not all prompts. The budget guide says its submission reservation cannot price the complete batch, releases that reservation, and records final cost later; batch throughput needs separate controls. — https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/users

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [fact] Provider token accounting differs: OpenAI documents an admission estimate involving max_tokens and request size; Claude OTPM counts actual generated output and ignores max_tokens. A gateway reservation does not replace either upstream limit. — https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/rate-limits · keywords: LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits · also: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/proxy/hooks/parallel_request_limiter_v3.py

- [fact] At commit 82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96, personal user-budget checks skip team keys unless apply_user_budget_to_team_keys is true. This is commit-specific evidence, not proof of a deployed release default. — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/proxy/auth/auth_checks.py · keywords: LiteLLM virtual keys budgets and rate limits · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/82d8b3797cf124e2baaa9c342f87a57fbb3a1a96/litellm/proxy/spend_tracking/budget_reservation.py
